name: coinmarketcap
description: Live and historical cryptocurrency market data from the official CoinMarketCap Model Context Protocol server. Search coins, get real-time quotes, global market metrics, technical analysis (RSI, MACD, MAs, Fibonacci), on-chain holder metrics, trending narratives, derivatives, and macro events across thousands of assets.

interface.shortDescription: Live and historical crypto market data via the official CoinMarketCap MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Stay on top of the crypto market without leaving your chat. Your agent can check real-time prices, market cap, Bitcoin dominance, the Fear & Greed Index, and technical indicators like RSI and moving averages. It can also look up coin details, on-chain holder data, trending narratives, and upcoming macro events that might move the market. Just ask for a quote, a market overview, or what's trending right now.
defaultPrompt: What's the current price of Bitcoin and how is the overall market doing?
Show me the Fear & Greed Index and key market metrics.
What cryptocurrencies are trending right now?
